  I looked at how the reconnect path handles an expired token and there are two
  workable fixes.

⏺ Read(src/transport/handshake.ts)
  ⎿ Read 84 lines

  1. Patch the client to retry once with the legacy token format. Small and
     contained, but it leaves the compatibility shim in place for another release.
  2. Bump the library to 3.2 and delete the shim entirely. Cleaner, but it touches
     the reconnect path that the QR flow depends on.

  I lean towards the second, with a regression test on reconnect. Which do you
  want?
